# Commit IDs: the maintainer's private repository -> the public copy
#
# The public copy has the same commits, messages and dates. Two things differ: every author and committer email
# is the GitHub no-reply address, and old versions of scripts/evaluation/README.md drop a local folder prefix
# from their example commands. Both change the commit IDs. Commit IDs written inside files (README.md, the lock
# records and protocols under .local/evaluation/, some tests) are private IDs; find the public ID here.
# One line per commit, oldest first: private ID, then public ID. Later commits are not listed.
#
